answer_1.quote: We explore openended text generation task. The data come from Ultrafeedback dataset, a large-scale, fine-grained dataset that contains diverse preference values, and Orca, a rich instruction-tuning dataset. We finetune two models of size 7B and 15B: Zephyr-7B and Starchat2-15B.

answer_3.quote: We evaluate algorithms using headto-head win rate between our method and the DPO baseline. We consider two evaluators: GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023) and ArmoRM, since the latter is the best model on the Reward-Bench leaderboard.
